# Unpublished launch information — owner review required

This is an internal content checklist, not a privacy policy or terms of service. Do not link it from the public page or deploy it as a legal policy.

Before replacing the public policy-status notice, confirm:

- Legal operator/trading name for the sole proprietorship and an appropriate business correspondence address. Do not use a personal home address by inference.
- Public support email or support URL, and the contact for privacy requests.
- What data the released app and website collect, purposes, processors (including AI providers), storage locations, retention/deletion, security measures, and user rights/contact procedures.
- Product availability by platform, prices/taxes, billing/refunds/cancellation if relevant, and service limits.
- Owner-approved privacy and terms text reflecting those facts, with effective dates.

Current product copy preserves the workflow status stated in main commit 9da5879. It does not independently certify app/backend readiness. Confirm that status against the release build before launch. No verified beta program is asserted. Planned features are not commitments to a release date.

The download buttons, store-modal text, QR illustration and store handlers remain intentional placeholders. Only the dialog accessible name was added.
